executive_summary: Tempo Labs is an AI-powered UI design tool that generates production code, targeting small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Founded in 2023 by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits, the company is part of the Y Combinator Summer 2023 batch. With a strong technical team and a clear product offering, Tempo Labs is well-positioned to meet the needs of SMBs looking for efficient design solutions. The company shows promise for further traction as it develops.
team: Tempo Labs was co-founded by Kevin Michael, who has a strong background as a founding engineer and head of product at Perpetua, which had a $150M exit. Peter Gokhshteyn, also a co-founder, was an early employee at Perpetua and led the engineering team from idea to product-market fit, with previous experience at Google, Bloomberg, and Zynga.
product: Tempo Labs builds an AI-powered tool that helps users design user interfaces and generates the corresponding production code.
market: The product is aimed at small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) looking for efficient UI design solutions. No specific competitors are mentioned in the data.
traction_signals: Tempo Labs is part of the Y Combinator Summer 2023 batch, indicating recent traction.
risks: The company is newly founded in 2023, which may pose risks related to market entry and competition.
As a startup in the AI space, it may face challenges in scaling and user adoption.
